name: Sit-to-Stand with Toe Raise

instructions.description: Sit near the front of a sturdy chair with feet under your knees.
Lean forward slightly and stand up by pressing through both feet.
Once standing, lift onto your toes briefly while staying tall.
Lower the heels and sit back down under control.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use a chair height that allows smooth standing mechanics.

variations.variationDescription: Adds a calf raise and extra balance challenge to the sit-to-stand pattern.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Remove the toe raise to simplify the task.

commentsNotes: Use the chair only for support, not momentum.
Keep the knees aligned over the feet.
